PayPal's working capital of $12,416M is positive; however, this metric has limited utility for PayPal because $36,357M (63%) of current assets and $40,107M (89%) of current liabilities are funds receivable/payable and customer account balances—offsetting balance sheet items that do not reflect operational working capital needs. These represent customer deposits and amounts due to customers, not true operational liquidity. Excluding these items, adjusted working capital is approximately $3,933M ($21,160M in operating current assets less $17,227M in operating current liabilities), which is positive but modest relative to company size.
